appStore.name: JabLab: Shadow Training
appStore.subtitle: Solo boxing form coach
appStore.promotionalText: Shadow box in front of your phone. JabLab watches your stance, your jab, and your guard — and tells you plainly what it can and can't measure.
appStore.keywords: boxing,shadow boxing,jab,cross,combat training,pose coach,solo workout,form check,stance,guard

playStore.shortDescription: Solo shadow-boxing training with live camera coaching — no bag, no opponent.

description:
JabLab is a solo shadow-boxing coach. Put your phone where it can see you, and it watches your stance, your jab, and your guard while you train — no bag, no pads, no partner.

What it measures, it reports. Scores are shown as bands until the thresholds are calibrated on real recordings — a precise-looking number we cannot back up would be worse than no number. What it can see but can't score fairly, it flags instead — a phone camera can't replace a coach's judgment on everything, and we would rather say so than fake a number.

MEASURED
- Punch events and count, for the punches we model (jab and cross)
- Stance width, crossed feet, and balance

WATCHED AND COACHED, NOT SCORED
- Guard hand position - we will tell you when it drops, but coaches disagree on exactly where it belongs, so we do not put a number on it
- Tempo — we work it out from the timing of your punches, but no screen in the app shows it to you today

WHAT WE DO NOT MEASURE
- Combination order and timing - we detect each jab and cross on its own; judging the combination they form together is not something the app does today
- Punch force or power - a camera cannot measure force
- Hook and uppercut technique - we ran a real hook lesson through the app and it missed almost every hook, so we do not score what we cannot reliably see
- Sparring, contact work, or anything that needs a second person to judge

Your camera view never leaves your device. Nothing from the camera is saved — not video, and not the body positions we read from it. Nothing is uploaded.

Solo training, honestly measured.
$measurementDisclosureLine: MEASURED / WATCHED AND COACHED, NOT SCORED / WHAT WE DO NOT MEASURE ucluu, description alaninin kendi icinde — HonestyBox'in (Discipline.measured/notMeasured) magaza karsiligi. ⚠️ Ilk baslik J-212'de 'MEASURED AND GRADED' iken 'MEASURED' oldu: bugun hicbir sey puanlanmiyor, yani 'GRADED' desteksiz bir tier iddia ediyordu. store_listing_test ucluyu artik SATIR capasiyla zorluyor (eskisinden siki; mutasyonla dogrulandi: baslik govdeye gomulunce kapi otuyor).
$combinationClaimCorrection: KOORDINATOR CAPRAZ KONTROLU (2026-08-12) — J-162/163'u KESIN cozdu: 'Combination order and timing' MEASURED'dan NOT-MEASURE'a tasindi. Olcum: WRONG_HAND_FOR_COMBINATION ve COMBINATION_ORDER_ERROR ikisi de evaluateAt:['COMBINATION_END'] istiyor (boxing@1.0.0.json); COMBINATION_END motor kodunda (lib/ + packages/jablab_engine/) SIFIR yerde geciyor — grep pozitif kontrollu. condition alanlari sequenceMismatch'e bakiyor (striking_engine.dart _Ctx) ve bu alan TEK YERDE tanimli (deklarasyon), HICBIR YERDE ATANMIYOR. evaluateAt dispatch'i (striking_engine.dart:495) `e.evaluateAt.contains(marker)` — marker motorun GERCEK faz kimlikleri (GUARD_READY/EXTENSION/PEAK/RETRACTION/GUARD_RECOVERED), COMBINATION_END bunlarin hicbiri degil → bu iki hata KALICI ERISILEMEZ. J-162/163'un 'hala gecerli mi' sorusu artik KESIN cevaplandi: EVET, ve suphelenden DAHA KOTU (kismi zayiflik degil, tam-olu mekanizma). ⚠️ AYNI ASIRI-IDDIA `boxing.foundations.one_two` dersinin CANLI ogretme metninde de VARDI ('We watch the order and the timing between the two') — koordinator hukmu (2026-08-12): sevk edilmis yalan tasklaktan ONCE gelir, AYNI TURDA duzeltildi + supurme yapildi (uc hata kodu ulasilamaz cikti, ucuncusu TEMPO_TOO_FAST_FOR_FORM yeni bulundu, hicbir canli metin ona dayanmiyordu) + genel kapi kuruldu (packages/jablab_engine/test/error_reachability_test.dart).

cameraPermissionRationale.ios: JabLab watches your shadow boxing to coach your form. The camera image stays on this device and is never uploaded, and nothing from the camera is saved — not the video, and not the body positions we read from it. Your session history (which lesson, when, how long) is stored on this device.
cameraPermissionRationale.$source: ios/Runner/Info.plist NSCameraUsageDescription — BURAYA KOPYALANDI, DEGISTIRILMEDI. Tutarlilik: description'daki 'never leaves your device' cumlesiyle BIREBIR ayni iddia.
cameraPermissionRationale.$correctedWhy: J-211 (2026-08-12): onceki metin *'the app only keeps the body landmarks it measures'* diyordu ve OLCULDU — uygulama HICBIR landmark saklamiyor. Diske yazilan her sey: sessions.jsonl (lessonId, completedAt, workedSeconds, unitsCompleted, plannedUnits, unitLabel, lessonClass — vucut verisi YOK) + onboarding_seen (tek bayt) + poz modeli .task (paketten cikarilan asset). Landmark yalniz o KARE icin yasiyor (resolution.frame!.landmarks -> iskelet cizimi), tampon yok. Cumle gerceklesmeyen bir saklamayi iddia ediyordu. 'never uploaded' yarisi DOGRU: uretim Dart'inda (34 dosya) ag cagrisi 0, ag paketi importu 0 — sabotaj-dogrulamali tarama (HttpClient enjekte->1, geri al->0). NOT: bu cumlenin IKINCI bir yuzeyi vardi ve onu `store_listing_test`in plist-tutarlilik kapisi buldu — plist duzeltilince kapi otedi, yani yanlis cumle magaza listesine de girmisti.

$notClaimed: Bu taslak 'cihazda dogrulandi/kanitlandi' TURUNDE HICBIR CUMLE ICERMIYOR — cihaz turu (KAMERA-KOPRUSU-CANLILIK.md §7.3-7.7) henuz yapilmadi. Description'daki her cumle BUGUN kod-gercegine dayanir (measured/notMeasured library.json'dan birebir), cihaz-performansi iddiasi tasimaz.
$claimAuditWhy: TAM IDDIA DENETIMI (J-212, 2026-08-12, koordinator sevki). 27 iddia olcume karsi denetlendi; her 'dogru/yok' bulgusu POZITIF KONTROLLU. 22 AYAKTA, 5 cumle duzeltildi (3 kok). (1) 'JabLab keeps the body positions it measures' — J-211 yalaninin UCUNCU yuzeyi. plist ve cameraPermissionRationale duzeltilmisti, description'daki kopya KALMISTI: tutarlilik kapisi YALNIZ cameraPermissionRationale'i plist'e karsi okuyor, description'i HIC okumuyor. Olcum: uygulama hicbir landmark saklamiyor. (2) 'Tempo, shown as a band' — tempoBands GERCEKTEN hesaplaniyor (ADR-001, faz suresinden) ama HICBIR EKRAN GOSTERMIYOR; library.json'in kendi serhi zaten yaziyordu: "'Olculuyor' dogruydu, 'goreceksin' degildi" — magaza metni tam o hatayi yapiyordu. Pozitif kontrol: ayni tarama 'round clock' 3 dosya, 'Scores are shown as bands' 2 dosya buluyor; 'controlled|brisk' 0. (3) 'What it measures, it grades' + 'MEASURED AND GRADED' + 'honestly scored' — bugun HICBIR SEY puanlanmiyor: lessonClass:'unscored' sabit, gradedBands her bileşen icin '—', calibrationPending:true. Uygulama-ICI metin durusttu; MAGAZA metni ondan GUCLUYDU — ayni cumle magazaya tasindi. stance+balance ruleset'te graded:true, yani kategori uydurma degil; yanlis olan SIMDIKI ZAMAN. AYAKTA KALANLARDAN olculenler: 'never uploaded' (ag 0, sabotaj-dogrulamali) · guard 'we will tell you when it drops' (REAR_HAND_LOW ULASILABILIR; ulasilamaz olan LEAD_HAND_NOT_RECOVERED ve magaza metni ona DAYANMIYOR) · 'punches we model (jab and cross)' (techniques: jab, cross, unclassified_strike) · hook iddiasi (artefakt workspace/HASAT-TURU-HOOK-UPPERCUT.md, ve kapi library.json'a karsi zorluyor) · ageRating 'uygulama ici tarayici yok' (webview/url_launcher 0, poz kontrol Scaffold 12) · $notClaimed 'cihaz-kaniti cumlesi yok' (0, poz kontrol gecti). ⛔ ACIK: description alani BIR BUTUN olarak kapisiz — tutarlilik kapisi yalnizca cameraPermissionRationale'i okuyor, ve UC yuzeyli yalanin ucuncusu tam bu yuzden hayatta kalmisti. Kapi uzatmasi Ostinato'da (koordinator sinir), YAZILMADI.
